cases.description: AP-03 editor authoring inside the REAL Starforge editor (Projects/Starforge/src/AP03AuthoringSelfTest.cpp): E01 New Project (kind app) -> F-APP tree equals templates/app -> the flow's start screen opens -> viewport non-blank -> BuildScripts -> Play (flow state Home, services instantiated) -> Stop; E02 Screens > New Screen 'Telemetry' + Create script (scene with canvas + ortho camera + NativeScript, flow state added byte-stable, stub header, include + CS_SCRIPT between the CS_SCREENS markers, rebuild ok, Validate empty, marker-less refusal with the documented message and no file change); F01 rename / set-start round-trip byte-stable + when/channel guard round trip; E03 injected pointer drag on the rect gizmo (one CommandStack entry, undo/redo, anchors untouched, SE resize edits OffsetMax only); E04 UiImage.TexturePath replaced with an imported PNG, saved, reopened, sentinel pixels in the viewport readback; E08 recorded Open/Reveal (COSMIC_AP03_RECORD_SHELL) for a screen script, the CS_SERVICE site (DataBus panel producer + Inspector Open producer), the CS_PANEL site (viewport context menu + Inspector), a bound widget channel and a button signal; V05 editor half (Diagnostics CS_PANEL drawn at the element's viewport-offset rect, also letterboxed; unknown name -> placeholder; never in edit mode; ImGui stacks balanced); E07 live loop (AppService.cpp rewritten while playing -> stop, rebuild, resume on the same flow state with services re-instantiated, amplitude changed, uptime history kept, Console build line; compile error -> stays stopped with the 'Build failed' chip; fix -> resumes); E06 homescreen lists App/Game/Blank + FlowDemo/ForgePong, each scaffolds/opens/builds/plays, LoadProjects <= 3 over 600 frames. The wrapper adds the OUT-OF-PROCESS oracles (F-APP byte comparison, E02 files + flow JSON, E08 recorded paths).
